admission.justification: A long-lived child must preserve safe reuse without letting large documents occupy the shared parse store.

applicability: The reviewer child's enabled exact-content document parse memo.
conditions: Reuse requires the same source bytes and candidate-specific placement validation.
The shared memo allows 65,536 entries and 256 MiB of charged retained data.
exclusions: Ordinary parsing with the child cache scope disabled uses its local reader path.
Index currentness and completeness are separate obligations.

evidence: bug-r18-isolated-reviewer-and-startup-results.md, same-history child base and repair with parsed-document charges.
handoff.path: BUG-L18 W2 affected knowledge and initial history

statement: The reviewer child reuses bounded document parses across worklists and leaves oversized documents outside its shared parse memo.
